title: ownpurse ui state (v 1)
description: The view state `ownpurse --json ui state` answers. Every key is always present; `--fields` projects dotted paths. Field reference: docs/TUI.md.

breadcrumb.description: Where the view is, top level first (strings).

build.description: The build identity (the git commit, `.dirty` with uncommitted changes), shown with the version as `0.12.1+g6dc723f`; null for a build without git.

busy.description: What the user is in when a send would be refused user_busy.

manifest.description: The shown manifest (null on main): name, stage, chip, head_rev, entries, issues {errors, warnings, acknowledged}, apply {sent, landed, verified, rejected, uncertain}, package_hash, approve_command, apply_command. There is no apply verb.

layers.description: Overlay layers on this frame: layer, owner (guide | agent:<name>), anchor, landed (on_screen | off_above | off_below | off_left | off_right | not_found), rect, box, reason, strip, no_arrow.

anchors.description: The overlay anchors drawn on this frame (row:…, cell:…, diff:…, chip:…, panel:…, viz:…).

narration.description: The narration panel when shown: title, body, by (the agent; null for a walkthrough step), why, scroll.

walkthrough.description: The walkthrough playing: id, title, step, of, step_id, failed_checks.

recording.description: A walkthrough being recorded: id, steps.

lay_mode.description: Lay mode (L): names before codes, why-lines.

caption.description: The agent's caption {text, by, rev}, or null.

classify.description: The Classify tab: mode, filter, selected_anchor, store_rev, open, stale, agent_writes, …

compare.description: The compare view (null when not comparing).

data_refreshes.description: How many times this session refreshed for other processes' writes (record, classification store, config); a burst of writes is at most two.

differs_only.description: Only accounts that differ from Xero are listed.

drift.description: Rendered from a drifted state (null live).

filter_applies.description: Whether a filter means something on this screen.

filter_matches.description: Rows the filter lets through (null without a filter).

history.description: back/forward availability and where they land.

input.description: The text being typed {field, text, caret}.

level.description: Drill level on the tab (1 = top).

mode.description: What the level shows (trial balance, postings, document, compare, pairs, log, queue, …).

record.description: The record the view is drawn from.

rev.description: The view revision: bumps once per change; pass it as --expect-rev.

rows.description: The rows on screen: {row, anchor, fields, selected}; --all-rows / --rows A..B for more.

scope.description: all, an org alias or group:<name>.

selected.description: The selected row's anchor (null when no row is selected or it is off screen).

selected_label.description: A short label for the selected row.

strip.description: The strip facts (record age, calls left, parity).

tab.description: overview | ledger | intercompany | activity | system | classify.

truncated.description: More rows exist than the answer carries.

update_available.description: A newer installed build, or null.

v.description: The state schema version (1); also the bridge protocol version.

view.description: {first_visible, last_visible, total_rows} (row numbers, 1-based; null when empty).
